arguments.sql:
WITH model_keys AS (
    SELECT name, version, COUNT(DISTINCT L1_model) AS l1_count,
           COUNT(*) - COUNT(L1_model) AS null_l1_rows
    FROM main.model
    GROUP BY name, version
),
score_steps AS (
    SELECT name, version, step, COUNT(CASE WHEN model = 'Stack' THEN 1 END) AS stack_rows
    FROM main.model_score
    GROUP BY name, version, step
),
status_keys AS (
    SELECT name, version, L1_model, status, COUNT(*) AS qualifying_steps
    FROM main.stack_ok
    GROUP BY name, version, L1_model, status
)
SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM model_keys) AS model_versions,
       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM model_keys WHERE l1_count <> 1) AS versions_without_single_l1,
       (SELECT SUM(null_l1_rows) FROM model_keys) AS null_l1_rows,
       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM score_steps WHERE stack_rows <> 1) AS steps_without_single_stack,
       status, L1_model, COUNT(*) AS model_versions_with_status, SUM(qualifying_steps) AS qualifying_steps
FROM status_keys
GROUP BY status, L1_model
ORDER BY status, L1_model;

WITH model_statuses AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT name, version, L1_model, status
    FROM main.stack_ok
    WHERE status IN ('strong', 'soft')
),
ranked_counts AS (
    SELECT status,
           L1_model,
           COUNT(*) AS occurrences,
           RANK() OVER (
               PARTITION BY status
               ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
           ) AS frequency_rank
    FROM model_statuses
    GROUP BY status, L1_model
)
SELECT status, L1_model, occurrences
FROM ranked_counts
WHERE frequency_rank = 1
ORDER BY status, L1_model
LIMIT -1
